preconditions.description: The input grid is square (all rows have the same length as the number of rows).
The grid size N satisfies 1 ≤ N ≤ 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= cost <= 1000 for row in grid for cost in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell cost in the grid satisfies 1 ≤ cost ≤ 1000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(sum(path) for path in paths)
postconditions.description: The returned value is the minimum total cost of any valid path from the top-left cell (grid[0][0]) to the bottom-right cell (grid[-1][-1]).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(grid) and 0 <= j < len(grid) for i, j in [(0, 0), (len(grid)-1, len(grid)-1)])
postconditions.description: The path must start at the top-left cell (0, 0) and end at the bottom-right cell (len(grid)-1, len(grid)-1).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(grid) and 0 <= j < len(grid) for i, j in path_indices) and all(abs(path_indices[k][0] - path_indices[k-1][0]) + abs(path_indices[k][1] - path_indices[k-1][1]) == 1 for k in range(1, len(path_indices)))
postconditions.description: The path consists of valid moves: from cell (i, j), you can only move to (i±1, j) or (i, j±1), staying within grid bounds.
